originalTitle: Will any manufacturer ship 1 GW or more of perovskite solar modules in a single calendar year by December 31, 2030?
title: 2030 年底前单厂商钙钛矿组件年出货会达到 1 GW 吗？
Will a manufacturer ship 1 GW of perovskite modules in a year by 2030?
rules: 任一厂商在 2026–2030 某一日历年商业出货钙钛矿或钙钛矿/硅叠层组件 ≥1,000 MW，须有可融资认可的质保。
One manufacturer must commercially ship ≥1,000 MW of perovskite or perovskite/silicon tandem modules in one calendar year during 2026–2030, with bankable warranties.
研究组件、试验项目和缺少上述质保的室内光伏不算；合计多年或名义工厂产能不算年度出货。
Research, pilots and indoor PV without bankable warranties are excluded; multi-year totals and nameplate capacity are not annual shipments.
interpretation: 题目看单一厂商、单一年度和有效出货，不是开工或产线设计能力。标题写“2030 年前”，细则又将可计年份限定为 2026–2030，读曲线时须保留这一范围。
This asks for one manufacturer, one year and qualifying shipments, not announced factory capacity. The title’s broad deadline is narrowed by the body to calendar years 2026–2030.

summary: 题目看单一厂商、单一年度和有效出货，不是开工或产线设计能力。标题写“2030 年前”，细则又将可计年份限定为 2026–2030，读曲线时须保留这一范围。
This asks for one manufacturer, one year and qualifying shipments, not announced factory capacity. The title’s broad deadline is narrowed by the body to calendar years 2026–2030.
checklist: 核对厂商年度净出货及组件技术。
Verify manufacturer-year shipped volume and technology.
查看质保、客户验收与商业用途证据。
Review warranties, customer acceptance and commercial use.
剔除试验线产能、多年累计与重复申报。
Exclude pilot capacity, multi-year totals and duplicates.

stage: 试验线 → 可质保产品 → 单年商业出货
Pilot line → warrantied product → annual shipment
impact: 首批商业出货说明产品已进入客户应用，却未披露符合本题的年度 1 GW 总量。组件效率、年产能和实际出货各有独立证据；长期质保又涉及湿热、紫外和封装可靠性。把这些阶段分开，才能判断扩产新闻是否真正跨过市场设置的交付门槛。

First commercial shipment establishes customer use but not 1 GW in a qualifying year. Efficiency, capacity and shipments need separate evidence; warranties add damp-heat, UV and encapsulation reliability requirements. Expansion news alone does not establish the delivery threshold.
gap: 市场参与较少，且 bankable warranties 未规定具体年限；不把出货传闻直接计入总量。
Participation is low and bankable-warranty duration is unspecified; shipment rumours do not enter the total.

title: 叠层效率、制造产能与实际出货
Tandem efficiency, factory capacity and shipments
principle: 钙钛矿层与硅层吸收不同波段，以提高入射光的利用率。电池效率经过互联、封装和有效面积损失后，才形成组件效率。制造线的额定能力还要经过良率与利用率，才能转为可销售出货。

Perovskite and silicon absorb different spectral bands. Module efficiency includes interconnection, encapsulation and area losses; nameplate factory capacity becomes sales only through yield and utilization.
example: Oxford PV 首批商业组件的 24.5% 效率说明了产品性能，年度 1 GW 则考查累计交付的额定功率。全球多数部署使用哪种材料，还需要统计整个行业的年度装机。
Oxford PV’s first modules had 24.5% efficiency; annual 1 GW concerns cumulative delivered rated power. A global-majority contract needs industry-wide annual deployment data.

label: 可计年份与质保
Eligible years and warranty
detail: 正文限定 2026–2030 年，且未明确 bankable warranties 的年限。
The body limits eligible years to 2026–2030 and leaves bankable-warranty duration undefined.

label: 参与较少
Few participants
detail: 概率来自少量参与者；查看成交数量与原始规则。
Few participants contribute; review activity and source rules.
